faehigkeiten.grund: Auslieferung wird je Abruf neu zusammengesetzt (adswizz vergibt je Abruf eine listeningSessionID, AIS leitet ueber hash_redirect um, Last-Modified liegt nur 2 s vor dem Abruf, Abruf laeuft ueber den Werbedienst simplecastaudio.com) - Byte-Offsets veralten (bei dynamischer Auslieferung sofort, gemessen 19.08.2026) und die Zeitachse verschiebt sich mit (eine Folge war 57 s kuerzer als 3,5 h zuvor), deshalb sind auch Sprungmarken in Sekunden unsicher

einzeiler: Martin Short talks about his early days in Toronto comedy and his friendship with Conan.
kurzfassung: Martin Short drops by to discuss taking Only Murders in the Building to London for its sixth season. He also reflects on the legendary 1972 Toronto Godspell production featured in the documentary You Had To Be There. Along the way, he and Conan trade playful insults and share memories of their comedy roots.
stichpunkte: Martin Short visits Aspen for his wife Liza's play and encounters hungry bears in town.
Writer Matt O'Brien unexpectedly interrupts the podcast via phone call.
Martin Short and Conan O'Brien trade elaborate comedic insults about each other's appearances.
The documentary You Had To Be There captures the 1972 Toronto Godspell production that launched many iconic comedy careers.
Martin recalls making elaborate imaginary radio shows in his attic as a teenager.
The conversation covers the close-knit and prolific generation of Canadian comedy legends from Second City and SCTV.
Martin and Conan discuss their respective experiences working with comedy pioneer Jerry Lewis.

clips.text: During a comedy show, Martin shouted this question repeatedly without realizing he was doing it.

clips.hook: I had an applause record from Sinatra at the Sands.
clips.text: As a teenager, Martin used two tape recorders and a live album to simulate performing for massive crowds.
When delivering an honorary mayor speech entirely in a Kennedy impression, only a tiny fraction of the audience got the joke.

beschreibung:
Martin Short feels sexually excited about being Conan O’Brien’s friend.

Martin sits down with Conan once more to discuss taking Only Murders in the Building to London for its sixth season, revisiting the 1972 Toronto Godspell production with the documentary You Had To Be There, remembering the uproarious Gilda Radner, and more.
